newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia aero engine plant sees 1997 sales doubling.
newsitem.headline: Russia aero engine plant sees 1997 sales doubling.

text.p: Russia's aircraft engine manufacturer AO Rybinskiye Motory plans to double sales of aero engines and other motors this year from 1996 levels, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.
It quoted the company's business plan as saying sales were planned at 1.56 trillion roubles after 800 billion last year.

The plant would produce 100 new engines for Russian Tu-154M, Il-62M and Il-76TD planes, 10,000 diesel engines for cars and tractors and 5,000 snowmobiles. The document did not say what last year's production was.
Rybinsk output is well below to Soviet-era levels, when the plant produced 300 new aircraft engines a year and repaired 400. Repair volumes have fallen to 150 engines a year.
About 60 percent of Russia's domestic aviation and about 80 percent of military-transport air fleet uses Rybinsk Motors' engines.
